data.name: Aftan
data.gender_notes: Aftan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'aftana', which means 'to provide' or 'to offer'. In Islamic context, Aftan signifies a giver or provider, often evoking images of kindness and generosity. The name Aftan carries the meaning “Giver, Provider” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aftan usually hope their child will grow to embody giver, provider and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Aftan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver, Provider.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aftan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أفتان
in_arabic.long_meaning: أفتان هو اسم عربي يعني الزهرة الجميلة والخجول، وهو مشتق من الجذر العربي أف تن، ويحمل دلالات إيجابية في الثقافة الإسلامية، ويرتبط بالجمال واللطف والخجل، وهو اسم شائع في العديد من البلدان الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: افتان
in_urdu.long_meaning: افتان ایک عربی نام ہے جو خوبصورت پھول اور شرم کے معنی میں آتا ہے، یہ نام عربي جڑ اف تن سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا استعمال برصغیر پاک و ہند میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان بکثرت ہے، یہ نام خواتین کے لیے بہت پسند کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अफ्तान
in_hindi.long_meaning: अफ्तान एक अरबी नाम है जो सुंदर फूल और शर्म के अर्थ में आता है, यह नाम अरबी मूल अफ तन से लिया गया है, और इसका उपयोग भारतीय मुसलमानों के बीच बहुत आम है, यह नाम महिलाओं के लिए बहुत पसंद किया जाता है

This title not only honors the person but also encourages others to emulate their acts of kindness.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aftan holds deep significance as it is reflected in the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Quran. The name Aftan is a reminder of this principle and serves as a constant encouragement for individuals to strive towards greater acts of kindness and giving.
